notes.title: Made With Pride Queer Creator's Showcase!
notes.content:
ShelfLife Art School Detective will be available at the SXSW Made With Pride Queer Creator's Showcase event!

Each year the SXSW Sydney Games Festival, curates themed showcases to give games a bigger spotlight, putting them together in a custom launcher and letting attendees run wild with them! 

Outside of our regularly scheduled showcase at SXSW (see our other post), a mostly-not-broken-please-don't-exit-the-map-menu demo will be available as part of the Queer Creator's Showcase!

This event will features heaps of great queer content running along a row of booths.

So if you aren't able to make our regular showcase session, go check it out, details below:

Location: UTS Great Hall SYDNEY, Friday 18th October
Times: 10am-2pm and 4pm-8pm*

*We are busy with important meetings and suchlike in the morning, but we will be trying to make an appearance during the 4pm-8pm session, so we may see you there!

Thanks,
Fnife

notes.title: Art School Detectives investigate SXSW Sydney!
notes.content:
ShelfLife: Art School Detective will be at SXSW SYDNEY next week!

If you're in the area (or have the ability to teleport) please come check out our demo!! We're going to be a part of two showcases, one on Thursday and one on Saturday.

We'll be exhibiting our 20+ minute demo at the UTS Great Hall, Building 1, 1/15 Broadway, Ultimo NSW 2007 at the following times:


 Thursday 17th - 10am-2pm - at Booth #30
 Saturday 19th - 11pm-6pm - at Booth #30

Come by and visit us! We'll be dealing with the emotional aftershock of having finished two events in Melbourne and living off muesli bars and throat lozenges, so the vibes will be vibey and the game will be gamey!

Hope to see you there!!!!!! ːsteamthumbsupːːsteamhappyː

notes.title: PAX Australia 2024
notes.content:
WE'RE AT PAX AUS

Slightly late in posting this on steam, but we're exhibiting ShelfLife: Art School Detective at PAX AUS!

We are at booth #1140 alongside 17(?) other fantastic New Zealand games, brought together through the support of the ever-wonderful NZ Centre Of Digital Excellence!

Please come down and check out our demo if you are in the area!

PAX AUS runs from the 11th to the 13th of October (2024) at the Melbourne Convention & Exhibition Centre. And we'll be exhibiting all day every day, baby (and getting sore feet because of it)!

Be there or be a squared! ːsteamhappyː

Check out the PAX AUS Steam event here: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/paxaus
